I'd give Erawan a strong like. The food is really great, definitely among the best Thai I've had in Philly. The golden spring rolls are awesome, I am not a huge fan of the fresh veggie spring rolls. I really like their Pad Thai and the Pad See Ew. Delish! Their ability to handle a crowd, on the other hand, is questionable. The last time I came in, it was with a group, we had a reservation, it was empty when we got there. The staff was, initially, awesome. But, as the restaurant filled up, the service tanked. We spent nearly three hours there. And by the end, it was really hot, they stopped filling our water, and everyone needed to get out. Definitely order take out or delivery, but be cautious about heading over with a big group.

Fun spot with pretty good food, and pretty good service, RIGHT ON THE BEACH! Had a cool reggae band on Saturday at lunch. I am sensitive to fish that are preserved in sulfites and this place seemed to have very fresh fish. went back a 2nd time, service was still good.

So this is a pretty sly little place to grab some ( obviously Vietnamese / Chinese ) food. The restaurant is clean, bathrooms are clean, neat decor. Widespread menu, though I can speak only of one item. That was a good bowl of motha pho. Ok, it was just pho, but yeah... Excellent serving size, nice plate of add ins. Could see the bottom, but didn't quite finish. That means I owe it another visit...

As a two timer to this place, the first time I ordered take out from miles away to have the closest Indian food to my home. We had a scrumptious meal of luscious, tender saag paneer and velvety smooth chicken tikki masala. I would probably have hit a "5" button except at a recent attempt for a reinactment of my magnificent meal, I came for a lunch buffet and was treated to less than fresh semi-dry crusty appetizers, some chicken dishes but mostly vegetable entrees, but delicious rice, fresh drinks and very friendly staff. I would have given that meal a 2 or 3 but the service a 5. I have settled now on a comfortable 4 due to the advice I'm going to tell you: in all Indian places, you will get the freshest food for dinner cooked to order, not in a buffet. Buffets are more casual and you cannot choose, there will be no menu and what you get is what you get, so do yourself a favor and come for dinner. Don't forget the lassi.

Ok the food is so good,I loved the Hummos and the Kebab was so delicious,BUT if you're hungry and planning to go somewhere,here would not be a good idea.they take too much time to bring your appetizer and food and even the water

The drinks are creative unique and just amazing. Food quality is superb. The lamb meatloaf sandwich is very comforting, savory and full of flavor. The meat and cheese plattet is to die for. If you're looking for quality dining.. this is the place and groovy atmosphere. Highly reccomended!
Still the best Gyros I've found around St. Louis. Service is always great and friendly.
Great food and ambiance!! The kanafeh is a must have!!!! The staff was friendly and helpful. They are building a beautiful garden. Can't wait until it opens.

A perfect place to stop for a date night dinner (before the Grand perhaps). The service is friendly and not over the top. Typical Indian cuisine but the execution is top notch and very consistent. I ordered the Vindaloo medium. Could have used a bit more heat to elevate it but the flavors stood out. Nice chunks of chicken. The basmati rice was tender and crisp. Well worth the trip! Try the tomato soup. Bold cilantro flavor.

Alright so in front of the building that I am currently at for work has two to three food trucks stand outside daily. On this particular day, Go Gyro Go was outside and Greek food is always a solid option since I am a big fan of gyros. The lines are pretty long here which I think proves that it is a solid spot but they do move very quickly. The folks on the truck are also super friendly and the yelp cover photo encompasses what types of personality I think they have. I have been here twice now and have had the traditional gyro and the Greek salad with chicken. The traditional gyro is solid and a perfect combination of tzatziki sauce and veggies in there with plenty of meat. Each bite is solid on this and don't forget to add the hot sauce if you like a bit of kick. The salad was also a solid option if you are feeling a healthier option. They do not skimp on the veggies at all and the chicken itself was solid as well which was a nice surprise because a lot of food trucks tend to make them on the dry side. All in all, a solid dining experience especially from the food truck genre. Definitely a spot I will continue to hit up during my time in STL.

I am writing this review for two reasons... Good food , Good management . Although i know braheem, when i first walked into the place i did not know it was his. The food is A++ and halal! spices flavors and sauces all on point. Prices reasonable. great service simple and welcoming atmostphere. AND MY WIFE LOVES THE CHICKEN SHAWARMA. its hard to get her to eat or try anything new!

Met some friends for drinks here last Saturday and had a great time! They have a very nice outside patio with full bar. The bar tenders were quick to serve and really nice. I didn't order any food so I can't comment too much but I did try a grit dish my friend ordered and it was very good. Would definitely go back again.
Very good food! We love coming here. Chilly Chicken is by far my most favorite dish, and I always kick up the spice! And we can never get enough of the naan,

I travel all over the country 40+ weeks out of the year. The food at this place is as good or better than Mediterranean/Haifa places in San Francisco, New York, Chicago - you name it! Great service, nice enough decor, and the place is clean.

We ordered through GrubHub tonight. Fiancé had NY strip, with mashed potatoes, and was quite happy (delivery steak!). I had the Lamb Kofte, which was amazing - perfectly spiced, and a good value. Knocked them one star for the marinated olives not being gluten free as advertised. There was some cracker that registered as "low gluten" on my Nima gluten tester.

One star is due to the lack of service and how cold the restaurant was. The food on the other hand is amazing. GREAT Pho and Spring rolls and Pork bahn mi. I watched three tables get up and leave due to no service. There were two employees there that day waiting tables each one kept telling the guest that the other girl would be right out. I'm sure they were cold. The last table tried for twenty minutes to get service and watched both servers help other tables. OH and it is cash or check only. No signs on the door to let you know before you sit down. They are at the register at the BACK of the restaurant.

Great food and excellent service. The staff goes above and beyond to make you feel at home. They have great lunch specials. I am always satisfied and happy with my meal. I highly recommend this place.

I have lived in Carp for almost four months now and Siam Elephant is one of the two restaurants I frequent the most. Great thai food made with very fresh ingredients every time I go. The atmosphere is warm the staff very friendly and the prices are decent. Ive tried about half the menu and everything is delicious. My usual: Pri King with brown rice and a thai iced tea.....awesome every time! This is the place I take people to when they come in town to visit. This is the first restaurant I recommend to anyone who asks.! 5 stars!
Very cool building, friendly staff, and great cocktails. I had the hummus, egg salad, and a flatbread -- all were solid. I would definitely come back for happy hour on their patio.

Mofongo, mofongo, mofongo. get it. We came here for lunch on a Monday. My friends are puerto rican, so they wanted to try this out while we were in Nashville. I'm glad we did. There is a parking lot, so parking is pretty easy. Though I think the parking lot must be shared with businesses nearby, because even though there were only two parties, including ours, in the restaurant, there were only a couple spaces open. It was cold inside. It has a big open concept, so it must be difficult to heat. Just be aware that you will be wearing your jacket indoors. The food is very authentic. My friends loved it here. One got the chicken mofongo and loved it, another got a side of the yucca mofongo and it was delicious. We got an appetizer of the tostones and it was very good. I got the gumbo to try to warm up. I liked it. For some reason I wasn't thinking of it like a soup, but that's what it is. The prices are on the pricier side, but for what you get it is worth it. The portion sizes are on the smaller side, but the quality is very good (exactly what you'd expect from this price point. I will never understand large portion sizes). Just don't come expecting the prices of street food. If I come back to Nashville, I'll be back to get a dish of the mofongo.

I ordered a noodle dish and a crab rangoon. I asked them to make the noodle dish "thai hot" and reiterated that I wanted it as spicy as humanly possible... it was not spicy at all! No heat whatsoever. Bummer. The portion was also really small for the price. Overall I was not that impressed.

The presentation alone is sweet but the taste is even better! This soup was recommended to us by a very bubbly waitress. It's actually a variation of what's on their menu. I don't know if it's word for word written on their but it's the Tom yum or kha whichever one is not coconut based. With clear noodles and seafood. It was fantastic!

I've been to PF Chang's a handful of times and I can happily say, I always love pretty satisfied. It's a happy medium between casual and upscale dining - casual enough for jeans but mood lighting and prices make it a nice romantic dinner date night for two. Service was super attentive, quickly seated and quickly served. We decided with the PF Chang's four course for two which was quite the deal. We get two soups, an appetizer, two entrees and a dessert - all for 42.95! On top of that, we ordered an extra two sides and we were so full. We were struggling to finish and ended up having nicely wrapped leftovers at the end of our meal. Everything we picked was very different of each other, which was our main objective. We wanted a combination of different flavors so we picked savory, sweet, spicy, salty, and saucy. It complimented each other very well and everything was pretty delicious. My only complaint was that the Mongolian Beef was a bit too salty and too strong which means you can compensate with the huge bowl of brown rice they give which worked out fine with me. The check was a but pricey but I would say it's worth in both the quality and quantity of the overall meal!

I went here on a Friday night with some friends. We ordered the veggie combo and the doro wot. The veggie combo was okay, but a bit lacking in flavor. The doro wot was laughably bad. The "chicken" they served us was almost entirely just bone. It looked like someone ripped most of the meat off a few chicken thighs, then stuck the bones in the doro wot sauce and served it to us. The sauce was, like the veggie combo, okay, but not as flavorful as other places, like Abyssinia. The service and restaurant cleanliness didn't seem any better than the other Ethiopian places in west philly, and the service was not anything great.
Delicious authentic Thai food and very kind service! They even brought me a little bowl of coconut ice cream for my birthday. :)

This is our first time trying Persian food. The restaurant is inviting and beautifully decorated. Our waitress Jacqueline was knowledgeable and attentive. She recommended that we try the Tour of Persia. The meal was tasty and packed with flavors. We will be back soon to try some of the other yummy dishes.

I wanted to write this review after seeing so many negative ones. I hope that potential diners take these bad reviews with a grain of salt, they are not justified in my opinion after two visits here, one just a few days ago, and one in 2014. Several reviews mentioned cost, it may be considered high to some but you have to consider the area. These prices are comparable to what others are charging nearby, and some of the other establishments are not BYOB. Also, each time I've dined here I was able to get a groupon that actually made this place a bargain! I noticed that several other tables also had coupons to use, and the other restaurants nearby do not have these offers. As far as the food, one reviewer stated that the chefs were "competent" and that is a good description. But you need to also consider the ingredients, and in my experience they are very good( I've had both fish and shellfish here and can assure you mine was not frozen as one reviewer stated) Several reviews mentioned the salads and they are very nicely composed and completely fresh, big enough to share as well. For diners looking to challenge themselves, or interested in seeing chef's interpretations or exotic cuisines, this is not the place. But if you want a simple, well executed, mediterranean influenced meal, this is a great choice. In my experience the wait staff has been very good. On my most recent visit I looked at the dessert tray and was tempted( we were told all items are made in house and they looked it too) but was so full that I could not eat another bite. If you live nearby or visit this area from time to time, keep on the lookout for groupons and try Francisco's!
We very much enjoyed the food in this restaurant. That was the best Thai food we've had in a very long time. We ate on the sidewalk. The service was great. We will be back.

This place is a regular for me. Everything I've had here is fresh and delicious. Surprisingly the sushi was great as well. The pad se ew is the absolute best. It's not on the menu but the still make it. It's delicious. The Thai fried rice is great as well. Great, relaxing atmosphere and great food!
Had a chance to try Parkallen with a coworker. We went for traditional Lebanese food and it was fantastic! I hear their pizzas are good too, but I didn't get a chance to try them.

Clearly one of my favorites ... when we arrived we where greeted by 2 beautiful hostess Gisselle and Brittany which quickly took us to our table... the Restuarant is beautiful with a great outside area which is perfect for parties or weddings .... at first we decided to order just a couple dishes to share but we really couldn't stop ourselves from ordering more everything sounded amazing and interesting ..... the food was absolutely delicious !! I mean the flavors are spot on and their homemade bread you can't stop eating it ! Our cocktails were well made well balanced .... then dessert we decided to ordered all of it !! after such great flavors for dinner we knew dessert had to be incredible and we were correct ... I was able to take a picture before my guest devoured it .. lol ... definitely would recommend this restuarant and definitely will be back.

When traveling to the American Southwest, what else would you do besides find an amazing Indian restaurant? That is exactly what we did. Located in a rather non-descript storefront in a strip mall that looked like any other was quite possibly the best Indian food I have experienced outside of London. We arrived on a Sunday around 7pm, without a reservation and the place was packed. They told us it would be about a twenty minute wait so we found a spot to stand and readied to wait it out. I never did figure out the host's system for seating people, but that twenty minutes proved to be only about ten, but even if it had been the full projection, it would have been worth it. We went with our standards and we're not disappointed. The serving was more than ample and not that expensive. We had plenty to eat and had some left to take with us. I never would have expected to find such a great Indian food experience in a hole in the wall in Arizona, but I'm glad we did. If I am ever back in the area it is definitely a place I would return to.

Cinco de Mayo.. La Multia... 2014... Review #300! I'm glad La Mulita decided to open for Cinco de Mayo AND that they carried their lunch menu all day, because this was the perfect place to spend the evening. My group of 4 arrived right around 7:30 and got a) front row parking and b) the picnic table to spread out around. This place was packed, but we apparently timed it right and everything worked out perfectly. No May 5th is complete without some guacamole, so it was ordered almost the second we sat down. The portion was a little smaller than I expected, but we ordered a couple more appetizers that we all shared and it seemed to work out. Food was delicious. I had a steak taco and a pork slider, and both were outstanding. I wish they would have come with a little side of tortilla chips though - some of the steak escaped and I had to use my fingers to scoop it up. Yeah, I could have asked for a fork... but where's the fun in that? I was introduced to Kale chips here... something I have never had, but will definitely be making at home in the very near future. Delicious! My personal opinion--I would probably come here for lunch and skip it for dinner. The menu is limited for dinner, and a lot of the options that sounded appealing to me weren't available at dinner. I've also been told the fire and ice cocktail served next door isn't available here. Boo.

Super super super surprised. This place made my day. I never expected to find the quality and authenticity of this caliber. I put this restaurant up against any Thai restaurant in the United States including Lotus of Siam in Las Vegas. Simply wonderful and charming it's a must.... now my favorite place in the city of Newport Richie.

Solid BYO. Always a favorite. This is my go-to hot spot for quick delicious affordable seafood in QV. I am always most satisfied treating it like a tapas style restaurant. Its great for a couple or a double date. I order the scampi or the pil pil, the fried calamari and dip each piece in the feta arrabiata sauce that comes with the oh-so-wonderful sweet al dente snap peas. I start the meal off with the greek salad and end it with a rice pudding. Always leave with a smile. Its loud and sometimes rushed but if you're looking for a delicious seafood treat its fantastic. Octopus is nice too as is the ciopino. I would order more entrees but I'm not a rice or escarole fan so its simply not worth it. The portions have gotten smaller and the prices seem to be creeping up but I get it...the market is struggling. Every bite is still worth it! (Keeping it a BYO helps the pocketbook). LOVE DMITRIS

Quick lunch with colleague. Tuesdays are half-price tacos and I ordered the Ahi Tuna tacos which were good and great plantain chips that come with it. Thoroughly enjoyed their brussels sprouts. Colleague had a very nice salad with chicken. Wooden doors going back again when in the Wilmington area.

Excellent authentic trinidad food has always been difficult to find in philly but our 10 year search landed us at this amazing restaurant last week. Even more impressive than the food were the interactions with the owner and his son. From the moment we walked in it felt more like going into a friend's house than just a restaurant. Within minutes we learned a great deal about their vision and plans for the restaurant as well as a great deal about what led them to the restaurant business. My wife felt like she had stepped back to trinidad between the music the decor and the food. We not only ordered dinner there but also a whole bag to sample at home. Everything was well seasoned and the variety of foods was impressive. We will definitely be returning again soon and for those who never had trini food be sure to ask for the peanut punch

Not spicy. Expensive and small portions. If you ask for spicy it's super toned down. Service is basic. Water. Food. Check. No extras. Nice spot on state street but we actually left to find more Thai food after going here.

Probably a favorite within Indian cuisines in indy area. They have lots of options, great service, and the food has just been getting better since they opened. They bring fresh naan to the table if you go for the lunch buffet. My favorite dishes are the daal makhni and chicken makhni. They have the same name but taste completely different! A go to spot for our family to take guests!

Waiter was super friendly and knowledgeable. Cocktails were absolutely amazing. I particularly liked the take on the Midori sour. As far as food, the lamb and chicken were off the charts delicious. The fried cheese and grape leaves were also enjoyable.

Torn between 3 and 4 stars. Would give it 4 stars for value - had the lunch buffet with iced tea for under $10. Would give it 3 stars overall. Should keep rice on buffet line steamed so it doesn't get hard and could keep the place a little cleaner.

The food was phenomenal, the servers were very polite. I have eaten at a number of Thai places in the area and Thailand has the best Thai food I've found. Great atmosphere and very reasonable prices. Definitely worth a drive and would recommend to anyone looking for quality Thai food.

This place was phenomenal, I first got introduced to Mediterranean food through Zoe's kitchen and told my husband TOU HAVE GOT TI TRY THIS PLACE, he said oh honey if you liked that place wait till you have real Mediterranean food and so on a weekend get away we stopped here and he was so right The flavors of the food were amazing extremely fresh service like no other I wouldn't even know where to start to describe to you what a wonderful experience we had here. Definitely worth it.

My favorite Indian place in the area. Consistently great food, attentive service, good value for money. An odd location, but a very nice, impeccably clean, restaurant with comfortable seating and a full bar. Buffet on Wed nights is terrific, always varied, and always busy. Their chicken tikka masala is the best I've had, and their spinach ball appetizers are fantastic.

Totally neglected this wonderful review! Came here for an ISC evening out and absolutely loved the place. We ordered several dishes to share but I went with the Shrimp Tom Yum Noodle Soup....EXCELLENT choice if I must say so myself. It was a heaping amount of succulent shrimp, rice noodles, fish ball, fresh bay leaves and flavor bursting additives. The spring rolls and fried corn fritter thingies were also pretty mouthwatering. The ladies serving us were very pleasant and attentive. I couldn't finish my Tom Yum so the young lady kindly packaged it to-go and turned my plain ole brown paper bag into a beautiful swan. I appreciated that. Thai Country Cafe is located in the Loop just west of Shell gas station and east of Mission Taco. Give it a whirl. ~Christy
I amost dont want to post a review so others wont realize how amazing this place is!!!!

I couldn't seem to find a decent spot near my hotel for dinner, so I started surfing Yelp. I must say, I was not disappointed by Zeko's. The chicken kebob platter with jasmine rice, black beans, and chop chop salad was really tasty. They provide a cayenne pepper sauce, but bypass that alltogether as it takes away from the seasoning and flavor of the chicken. There was so much food, I couldn't finish it. Everything was very fresh and was still hot when I got back to my room. I will definitely be back.

A gorgeous spot with delicious food and lovely cocktails! I love the ambience, especially so much outdoor dining and lounging area. I'm working my way through the menu, and have really enjoyed everything I've tasted - the ingredients are fresh and interesting. Happy hour is great, and I love sitting at the outside bar - the perfect combination of outdoors and inside. Definitely worth a try!!

I feel like this place is either hit or miss with some people. I've only ever ordered for delivery and just based on that experience, I haven't been disappointed. Our food always arrives hot and within a decent time frame. The lamb and the chicken dishes that I've ordered have been very flavorful and fresh. I'm always surprised at the amount of food you get. I almost never finish my entire meal! Whenever I have a craving for Indian food I'll be ordering from here.

Great food and even better service! There's lots of wonderful options for vegetarians and carnivores alike plus the staff is happy to explain anything on the menu. It seems small from the outside but the ambience on the inside makes up for it. We had the Queen 8 sampler dish. It's 4 chicken/beef dishes and 4 veggie dishes (or you can make them all veggie). We also got the appetizer sampler platter for 2. I would definitely recommend this combo for anyone not familiar with Ethiopian food. Absolutely coming back!

Ordered Gobi 65 and Chicken biryani over the phone for pickup. Menu online said boneless for the Biryani but that was not available. I had my reservations but love the taste of the biryani and ordered anyway. The flavor of the rice bowl biryani was awesome, but it is 98% rice and spice. The meat was 2 drumstick bones that looked like they were used! Almost NO MEAT. The Gobi was tasty but needed some kind of flavor balance and the lemon that came with it was needed. The fried curry leaves was almost the best. Bill came to $22.50 with tip and I must say I am torn. Value wise not worth it...spices awesome. I saved most of the rice for tonight...but feel they get 2 stars. Rice is cheap. Spices and artisan cooking happy to pay, but value was lacking.

I love pollo tropical's food. I've been going to other locations for years. This location, however, is incredibly slow. Do not go during lunch time unless you plan on waiting 20 minutes for your food. Staff is friendly but don't seem to know what's going on. Need better management and faster service.
Great for gluten free options. Got breakfast and didn't get sick! Cute atmosphere, and clean restrooms.

I really enjoy this place. It helps that the location is super convenient to me. The menu isn't too elaborate but they do a first rate job on everything. My only advice is not to show up super hungry because it takes a bit to expertly prepare these sumptuous meals.

I have eaten here a few times and it's consistently been great. Just about every thing has a vegetarian option, which is great, and it's always nice and tasty. The best thing to do is go in a group of 3 or more, each get different things and then share it all. It's great for new-comers to the neighborhood who are tight on cash. You get a great meal for a great price. Their hours can be kooky and the place is really small, so make sure you investigate before you decide to go. I've gone a few times and not been able to get a table or found out that they're closed. Oh! Definitely don't venture from the norm on the drinks. Some of the drinks they offer are, well, terrible. It's BYOB, though, so just bring some good wine and enjoy!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in town, and the Pho is amazing. One of the down sides recently, is that there is no consistency in the spring rolls. Sometimes they are made with only shrimp and sometimes it is shrimp and pork. As a vegetarian who eats only seafood, this is really important, and when asking the server for the shrimp spring roll and being brought the spring roll with pork, this is sort of disappointing.
Not overly impressed with the Greek food in particular. The Italian isn't bad, but the gyro was just underwhelming.

Great food, great service. My mentally challenged friend spilled his tea and the waitress immediately cleaned it up for him and a waiter had another tea for him before he even sat down. Great experience.

business_name: Taj Mahal Homestyle Indian & Pakistani Cuisine
text: The Taj Mahal was incredible. When we went, we ordered curry and eggplant and it was out of this world. The yellow curry *I think* was the best thing that I've eaten in a very long time. There was just enough spices to create a party in my mouth! The eggplant was also amazing. Since I am allergic to wheat, we opted to try the gluten free Naan. I thought it was great, but my partner did not like it one bit. Overall, this place was wonderful and I am so glad I discovered it!
Not worthy of the franchise. No one knows what breast of chicken is since I was given a thigh. Funny they sure know how to charge me for it. Awful.

Great chai, ginger fennel is on point. Very cute space, cozy and bright. Veg curry bowl, samosa chaat, bread basket - all good, especially the pickle w the curry. Our server Rohan was a sweetheart, love him!

Incredibly awesome place for Thai food ! The service was extraordinary and the staff was extremely friendly ! The food was authentic and mind blowing! Our whole meal was vegetarian and every dish had just the right amount of vegetables. Green Vs Red curry, Red curry was the winner. Basil fried rice had just the spice level we asked. Drunken noodles were one of the best I ever had. Each and every single bit of food was worth the penny spent :)

This place is scrumptdiliumptous!!! Seriously! The food is fresh and authentic. The servings are very adequate for two to share! I'm in love with the pickled vegetables given as a complimentary app. I have tried the beef kefta, but my favorite is chicken shawarma (sure I spelled that wrong). The pita is fresh and you can always ask for more if you run out. Try the babagonoush (misspelled?) and house salad. For dessert, I tried the baklava cheesecake. That's right, cheesecake. It was phenomenal with a side of Turkish coffee. If you have never tried Turkish coffee, be aware that the ground sediment is at the bottom of the cup. It's a different taste, so one either likes it or hates it. I didn't give 5 stars because I feel the ambiance could be a bit cozier and the staff is hurried (although it's not busy). Try this place! Will not disappoint!

I've been to Umami a few times now and they never disappoint. Friendly staff, nice atmosphere, delicious food and lots of choices for drinks. It's great to have such a wonderful option in Lenox Village.
Both my husband and I got diarrhea after eating there tonight. We have dined there many times and enjoyed the experience but this unfortunately must have been food born illness.
This is my first review every and no joke this is the best Asian food I've every had in my freakin life. Everything we had was amazing !! Coming back here every time I come back to Reno ! Delicious!
I go here many times with my husband. I love Chicken pita, fries and Tabuli salad! The owner is nice as well.

Had lunch here on Saturday 3/9/13. It had been many years since we had ventured to this area of town for a meal but when my wife suggested it we made a quick decision. Prices are great. The problem for we southerners is that though we like this kind of food we're never quite sure what to order as the menu is geared for people that understand the cuisine a bit more than we do. The wait staff tries to help but they're very agreeable with anything you ask about. We started with two orders of spring rolls (#3 and #5 if I recall - shrimp & pork) both of which are served with a peanut sauce. Very good. My son had the Pho with rare steak & meatballs which was excellent (brought the rest home and finished last night). My wife had one of the rice dishes and I had a shrimp omelette (sorry I can't recall or find the descriptions on line). Both were good. My son ordered a Jack fruit smoothie to go. He has had just about every fruit smoothie known to man organic or processed so I was surprised when he ended up tossing most of it. Will go back again...maybe we'll all get the Pho. :)

Can't get enough of the vegetable summer rolls! Tried the wonton and roasted pork noodle soup for the first time this visit and will definitely order again. This place is fast becoming a new favorite.

After having pho on the west coast and east coast in more diverse locations, I was really hoping for a great Vietnamese restaurant in my home state/city. Saigon did not disappoint. I have had the congee and chicken pho here and they were delicious. Coupled with a very casual atmosphere and the homey feel of obvious regulars visiting this restaurant, I will definitely be coming back for more. I'm so glad Indy has gems like these!

A co-worker went here and asked if they would deliver to our work in aston, and they said they would. Yesterday I called with a few questions, the woman who answered was verify kind and helpful. She reccommended I fax our order over since it was so large. (about 15 people). I called back later to make sure they received the fax, and a very polite gentlemen confirmed they did, and called me back shortly after with a total. I received a call today from the woman letting me know the order was on the way. Very polite driver, no mistakes, everything was delicious. They even gave us some complimentary 2 litres. A very thorough, professional, accomadating business that will surely be hearing from us again!

Had to say - torn between 3 and 4-star. Maybe 3.5 stars but going with 4 here. I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt because I walked in 15 minutes before closing. Pho with rare flank, well flank, and tendon. At first, I didn't see any noodles and was concerned. They rushed my order because my meat was still uncooked in my bowl. I guess they figured it was going to cook while I watched TV. Thai Tea was very sweet. Small size/portion. Compared to Miss Saigon, I prefer this place better. They are in the same parking lot. The TVs are a nice bonus. They usually have something interesting from a local channel on.
Some of the best Thai food we've had. The service was great and very reasonable price. Would definitely recommend.
I wanted to love my order but it was all too spicy. Looked good but didnt eat more than a bite of my pork tamale or elote. Sad. It took a long time and wasnt cheap. Please offer non-spicy options.
Accommodating, tentative, delish! Will for sure recommend. Yum!
amazing food, nice atmosphere. But horrible service. It took 20 minutes to get a drink order and an hour and a half to get food from when we got there.

I love it here! Music is hip hop/rap/trap music great decor. Great hookah and great service. The food and drinks are amazing and they have a great selection to choose from. There is no cover. The belly dancer is fantastic. You should no that this isn't a spot for dancing. The place is small and it is set up for a sit/chill kinda night.

Zeko's is a great go to for late night meals. During holiday seasons I tend to work a lot of overnight shifts. The fast food joints get tiring quick! My crew and I love to go there for an actual meal (not junk) on those nights. They have always been incredibly friendly no matter how busy it may be. My day crew has many more lunch options, but this is still one of our favorites. I LOVE the chicken pita and their fries. They season every perfectly for my taste. I have liked every single meal I have had their.

Great lunch spot. One of the few dog friendly places around. Worth the trip. A group of us visited for lunch (too early for live music)...enjoyed a well prepared lunch out on the deck with our birthday boy (7 year old bully pit)...he even got his own burger!

Not much selection! Okay. Me and my wife went here to try out their chicken. We had the wings and they were delicious. The sides though were extremely small and we were disappointed they didn't have much more to offer. Like I said the chicken was amazing, but felt that they should have had so more sides to offer besides coleslaw, potato salad, and a totally unappetizing looking mac and cheese.

We come back every so often to Shere-E-Punjab, and it's funny, because it seems like they step up their game every time a new Indian Restaurant opens up in the area. The food's always pretty good, but it's very cyclical. It will be fantastic for a while, and then it will start to slide down hill. As soon as there's some competition, they suddenly wake up and the food is fantastic. This last visit was fantastic, when we came for dinner. I love the chilli chicken, but they never have it on the lunch buffet. I usually have a hard time reconciling the price for dinner with the quality of the food, but not last time. For the first time in a long while it was back to the quality when it first opened. The lunch buffet is a whole other story- It's seems like Shere-E-Punjab gets to shine when they're showcasing their food for the buffet. Besides that, it makes for some fantastic people watching (according to Mrs. H.)

I first heard of Suraya from a friend who came here for dinner and having read soo many good reviews decided to stopby for brunch one weekend. This was my first time being in this part of town so it was an interesting experience. We started out with the crispy chickpea hummus, which as everyone has stated tasted amazing! I also got the falafel sandwich which was also good. Their rosewater lemonade is like a taste of heaven, i love how it smells just like roses and its sour! This place was so good I took my friend here for her birthday lunch the weekend after and I am sure there will be many more visits to come!

Brought 14 people for delicious buffet lunch. Flavors were distinct (not muddy like at some buffets). Dishes replenished regularly, very fresh, not put out in big vats. Favorites today were chicken tandoori, chicken meatballs, and pakora. Kids loved the naan, paneer, chicken tiki masala, fresh fruit, and fabulous mango pudding. Servers were especially friendly and helpful!

Had Indian food craving all day but I waited til 4pm to do anything about it. After driving from my go to spot to another only to find them closed between lunch and dinner, I eventually ended up at Taste of india. Love the Indian buffet and since I was there right at opening all the food was hot. The service wasn't very chatty and all business which was fine by me. In the words of a late 20th century poet/cyborg, I'll be back..
Food is delicious and service is outstanding. Finding a place with delicious burgers and Mediterranean food is hard to find. Zeko's nailed it.

I ate here a few years ago when the restaurant was under different ownership. The service and food was absolutely terrific. The owner came by and gave very personable service, gave drink refills promptly and provided me, even, refills of the delicious jasmine rice that came with my meal. I had tikki masala at this place and the recipe was very rich with plump shrimp. For the price, it was so cheap. I think I ended up paying around $12 for my meal, including naan. Now, from my understanding, the restaurant is under new ownership and the service isn't exactly up to par. I wanted to try something different, so I wanted to order the mango chicken platter. Uh-oh, they ran out of mango and the waitress tried to advise me that mango was not in season. Actually, in Florida, mango is in season from May to September, so that wasn't a reasonable excuse. So, I wanted to order the butter chicken, the same as my dining partner. The lady then butted in and suggested tikki masala. I thought, whatever, and ordered the shrimp tikki masala platter along with some garlic naan. My dining partner chose a keema samosa. They brought us some crackers, which was spiced and it was not at all mild. In fact, the crackers were spiced too hot. Not a perfect start to our meals. Basically, I sat there waiting for our appetizers and entrees with a burning mouth. In addition, the server wasn't as prompt with drink refills as I had to wave another person to provide me with a drink refill. Was the food great? The main entree was decent, but the shrimp wasn't as plump as before and the recipe has definitely changed. We never got a complimentary rice refill either. The server also did not split up our checks, and she ended up shorting me a few dollars, which ended up being taken away from her tip. (I know, it sounds like I'm being a douche, but its important to learn how to count and ring up checks correctly.) All in all, I don't think I will be returning that often. Maybe for a lunch buffet, but not for dinner as the service wasn't up to my liking.

Been here once or twice before. Great atmosphere, friendly staff, and delicious authentic food. Took my family after my graduation at SLU and the owner himself served us! He was so kind it was almost as if we had known each other. The price for the amount of food you get is great. No one in my table finished their whole plate and we're usually big eaters. The drinks are great too! They used to have a phenomenal bartender but word is he left. However, Warren the owner, makes a mean mojito and dominican rum punch. Definitely give those a try. Food is made when you order it but the wait is definitely worth it.
Great Thai place in Nashville. It's out of the way, but it's worth finding. The food is great and the price is reasonable. I highly recommend coming here!

I always go to Viet restos wherever we go because I just love Viet food, lol. Pho Orchid did not disappoint... I am surprised by the "meh" reviews. We took the trolley down, so parking wasn't a problem for us. We also went in a little before they closed, but they welcomed us. What I can recall, we ordered: - Bo Ne - Bun Thit Nuong Cha Gio - Pho My mom's Bo Ne looked and tasted delicious. It came with beef cubes and onions, sunny-side-up eggs, baguette with butter and pate (OMG, my favorite), and a side salad. My Bun Thit Nuong Cha Gio was good and very flavorful. The hubs' pho was decent, too. I forgot what my pops and cousin ordered, but they enjoyed both dishes much better than Lilly's and Magasin's. I know some people prefer Lilly's and Magasin's, but I would definitely recommend Pho Orchid over Lilly's and Magasin. When we go back to NOLA, we will be back to eat at Pho Orchid. Hope the food tastes just as great!
I want to eat lunch here everyday. Soup+the best spring roll ever+entree=$5.95. If you are a light lunch eater, there will be leftovers for dinner. I also suggest the papaya salad. It is huge!

I will not be patronizing this restaurant if the same bartender is there. I have been going to this restaurant since it opened, approximately 10 years ago. The food has never been anything aside from delicious. The service had always been nothing less than friendly and professional. Last night my friends and I went here to celebrate my friends 30th birthday. The bar was empty when we arrived around 11 and I had never seen the bartender who was working there before. My friends and I were not being disruptive or disrespectful in any way. The bartender decided to stop serving one of my friends I was with all night after 2 drinks. We were all disappointed and upset and it had a negative impact on the upbeat mood. We all had no idea why he decided not to serve her any more drinks, yet we continued to be served alcohol. My friend even asked the bartender while making their signature Martini what he used because she realized the menu implied it was made with Grey Goose and he put Stoli vodka instead. I never thought I would change my 5 star review to Shere E Punjab, and I will not be recommending this place anymore for the bar service. After seeing how this bartender treated one of my friends on New year's Eve and him using a cheaper vodka in 1 of the 2 drinks he served her, tisk tisk Shere E Punjab.
I love that he mentions quality to everyone. everyone gets the same story, but man is the hot sauce hot and the food delicious. very beautiful cart.

The best thing to get here are the soup dumplings. If you live in university city, you definitely need to try them here! They are dumplings with soup filled on the inside. The service is friendly and fast. I have not tried that much of the entree menu, but the couple of entrees I tried were just okay, maybe too oily.

If you like fresh seafood with simple, clean preparations Dmitri's is your place. The prices may seem a little expensive, but the portions are quite large, especially for seafood. We started with the hummus followed by the greek salad with greens. Both were big enough for 3-4 people. My husband had the grilled scallops, which are good if you like an intense char. I had the seafood fettucine, which included an abundance of clams, mussels and shrimp in a savory broth. We probably could have shared an entree there was so much food (see my pics). For 2, our bill came out to $60 including tip. A steal in my opinion considering we ordered more than enough. Next time, I'll take Tony N.'s advice and sit at the counter for dinner and a show. *BYOB & CASH ONLY
The hrs listed is wrong. We took a cab ($15) at 10:00pm and it was closed. They didn't even bother to pick up the phone. Too bad we couldn't try the food.

While I try not to eat fried food often, this place will make me break that rule. The chicken tenders are well seasoned and fried to perfection. I tend not to like white meat and prefer dark meat....and guess what? They have dark meat tenders!!! I'm in love.

First time visit, we absolutely love this place! Jason at the bar was very good! Food was perfect and exactly as we hoped. Staff is all very friendly and made for a nice lunch. Cool part is I ordered sushi and my wife had Chinese! Perfect hybrid lunch! We will be back!

Whenever I am going to be in a new area, I find myself taking advantage of the opportunity to try a new restaurant. I know nothing about the Drexel Hill area, but had read good reviews for this place. On my way from work to an appointment, I recently ordered takeout. Although they messed up my order (not sure how Chicken Makhani over the phone sounds like Chicken Tikka Masala??) I ended up receiving the best Chicken Tikka Masala I've ever had. The chicken was tender, the sauce was creamy without being too thick or runny and the "extra spicy" level I had requested was perfect. I found myself dangerously trying to sneak little spoonfuls out of the piping hot container when I was stopped at red lights. The basmati rice was also the best I've had..it was aromatic, warm, cooked perfectly and full of flavor. The garlic naan was delicious as well. I'm going to have to detour from my regular route home more often just so I have an excuse to come here.

This is me and my fiance's favorite restaurant (his family's fave, too). Everytime I go there, I order something different and I've never been disappointed. We have always gotten fantastic service (not sure if that's because everyone there knows my future in-laws), every single time. A very tall European man named Ivan has served us before, and he is wonderful - very attentive, but not smothering. I also like that the owner walks around the dining room all evening. You can tell that he really cares about your dining experience there. Every time I've ordered a steak there, it has been PERFECTLY cooked. They seem to be very consistent. My favorite dish is the Pepperloin a la Tenderloin. Just thinking about that steak with the amazing cognac sauce is making my mouth water!

This place is top three best spots I've eaten at in philly! The shrimp scampi is unreal! I never order shrimp out, but this is some quality shit. If you're looking for a quality byo.. Look no further than this joint.
my mouth waters when i think of the yummy food they serve. love the all you can eat buffet.

I just came from Bitar's with my husband for lunch today and I find their falafel is just blah! The falafel itself with my taste buds it was too dry for me. It doesn't have much flavor but with the tahini and baba ghonush it's pretty tasty. Would I go back there ...NO but I will buy their freshly baked pita bread and it's cheap!! I like their grocery and they have a variety of desserts to choose.

Love this place. Inside its a little out dated looking. But food good always. Place is clean staff is friendly. Service can be slow. They have a large selection and a variety of unusual choices. Prices good. Pumpkin pancakes and apple French toast a fall must.
Randomly stumbled in on this place..and Wow! Place is perfect for late night gyros...we kept coming back here...one of the best Ive ever had

The food was extremely mediocre, and overpriced for the portions they gave. I think this place banks on the fact that they don't really have competition with other Jamaican restaurants in the near area. The 2 small slivers of plantain that came with the meal was a joke. It was basically a garnish. I wouldn't even consider it to be part of the meal. I live in Philly, and was in the area. I normally go to Ron's Caribbean in Philly, and I guess they have me spoiled. My friend and I agreed halfway through our meal that we wouldn't be returning. Go elsewhere, or drive to Philly for good Jamaican food. I'm only reviewing the food and overall value, not the service. The service was totally fine, and our waitress was helpful.

Absolutely a must! Only a few steps from our resort Food is delicious especially the Orchid combination over crispy noodles. The coconut milk with tapioca was yummy! The staff was very attentive. Look forward to eating here again. We told our family and they went and enjoyed it as well.
I could eat a Chicken Mojo Cuban and wash it down with a caraffe of Sangria every day of the week!! A must try and the staff is awesome! Outdoor seating and a lovely atmosphere, as well. Take a date.
Fantastic. All the food was well cooked and well seasoned. The drunken noodles we're especially good.

It's small, clean and the staff is very nice! The young ladies were very professional, the service was great and the food was really good. The prices were very reasonable and I definitely recommend the fried rice!

Rittenhouse prices with small portions. We came on a Wednesday night. There were 3 other tables sat full of guests along with us, and it seemed as though the only staff member was waitress, server, and cook all in one. The food came out remarkably fast even after she was balancing take out orders, as well as the orders from the other tables. The decor and size of the place is very cozy. It felt like having dinner in someone's house. Thai papaya salad: good balance of citrus, sweetness, and crunch. Very tasty. Pad khi mao: reminds me of spicy chow fun. This was pretty awesome, and had a good amount of spice to it. Green curry: not that remarkable. Bland, skimpy on vegetables, and no spice whatsoever. Overall, this was a okay experience. Check came out to $40. I thought this was very pricey compared to the amount of food that we got. Definitely comparable to Erawan Thai Cuisine. If you're looking for strictly cheaper take-out, try Thai Singha House To Go.
Ordered pad thai and pad see ew ... both were not good. I recommend trying thai papaya instead which has excellent thai dishes.

High hopes, because the smell was tremendous outside: delicious spices on the cool night air. And the food was delicious: saag paneer, lamb rogan Josh, fish curry. But the service was sluggish and erratic, and we waited almost 15 minutes before we could make our orders. The meal was great, the waitress was friendly. But we realized it was Diwali, the new year, and things were a bit off-kilter. We'll definitely be going back again, and we liked the place and the people (and the prices), but it's hard to give a higher rating at this time.

Yeah, um, this place is not good. It smells phenomenal and it definately gets you salivating, but it just lets you down in the end. I knew I should've worried when there were no prices featured on their menu board, but I ordered away. I got a large stew of some sort (vegetarian) and a Jamaican grapefruit soda. It cost almost $20. The stew came with coconut seasoned rice and the flavor was passable, but the portion was not nearly large enough to justify the cost. And although the food was decent it was far from anything special and not something I couldn't make at home given the opportunity to take some root vegetables and some squash and cook the shit out of them until they're as mushy as baby food and throw them over some rice and beans cooked with coconut milk. Save your money.

Disappointing. First time very good but pricey. Most recently, after repeating our order, the waitress forgot our coconut soup, then brought an entree which was on the dinner specials which was so full of pepper it was inedible. She offered to dilute it then brought it back...more watery, but the noodles were soaked with pepper, which made it still inedible without a double dose of Prilosec. We left it sitting on the side, barely touched and were highly disappointed with being charged for the dish and also for the soup we didn't get. The soup was corrected but not the uneaten dish. The menu did not say that this special was spicy. Beware! Too many people trading off waiting the tables made for poor service. The main thing that was good was sitting outside on the street.
Roti and Curry items are Average ... Rice item specially biryani's is disaster in taste

I never had a chance to taste my food because the delivery guy was so rude to me. I had ordered only 1 fried rice combo and they had charged me for 2. Instead of correcting the mistake the driver gave me a nasty attitude and since I didn't have enough money for 2 orders, I told him to leave.

We had never had Thai food before! The owner, Preeda, suggested Thai Legacy fried rice and Pad Thai noodles! They were both excellent! It was a very good suggestion! Huge portions, wonderful flavor, great atmosphere! We will most definitely be back!

This place is so amazing. My boyfriend and I have been coming since it opened and we have yet to be disappointed. Every dish we have tried so far (chicken tikka masala, chicken korma, chicken jal frezi, chicken makhani, samosas, and MORE) have been so delicious and fresh (and hot!). The buffet has a lot of good options and is a really good value. My boyfriend says that the food here is better than in the Princeton area where there are a lot of indian restaurants. You are able to choose how spicy you want your dish and they make any adjustments you ask for. The portions are a great size, especially if you order take out. The staff is extremely friendly and attentive. I have no complaints about this place. PS the atmosphere is quiet, intimate, and really comfortable.
Best drunken noodles I have ever had. Bubble tea recently added to the menu! Quiet street, quaint neighborhood. 10% early bird discount. Outdoor seating. Good service.

I love the food here! It's been delicious and consistent all four times. The menu is way too long and confusing though so I just point to what I like. Seriously I think if the menu wasn't so intimidating it would help people with ordering.

I've come here for their warm soup and spring rolls and really enjoyed myself in this space that is the colour of Pepto Bismal. Everything's pink, and I kinda like it. The food comes quickly, the service is courteous and my meal was good. The only annoyance is they don't take debit, cash or credit only. But when I went in, the machine was broken. About half of the places in China town are cash only, which is a pain in the butt, but a lot of places are making it easier for customers by providing more payment options. You can pick-up and take-out here. They've got dinners for two to eight, and you can choose from 35 items, or order individually off of their menu of 110 items. This is quality food and they've got both Chinese and Vietnamese classics like Foo Young, Chop Suey, Pork Dumplings, Green Onion Cakes, Pho soups, and Creamy Peach Prawns that I haven't yet tried, but I tried them at Sukothai and will have to get them next time.

Ok so this was my first time, I will at least say I will give it another shot..my usual place I love bombay kitchen in lansdale. I got the shrimp Tika and it had a fried taste to the shrimp and the masalla sauce just wasent what I was used too. But what was horrendous was the wait for 2 items..almost 30 minutes when I placed the order online for pickup and they didn't even start it when I arrived to get it. One more shot like I said.

What has happened. Has Pho 36 been sold or under new management? Some of the people look new. No menus on the table, waited over 10 minutes for our order to be taken, and there were only 3 other tables filled with customers at 1:30PM. Mu husband ordered his usual plain Pho, and he said it was horrible. It also didn't look very appetizing either. It had huge pieces of uncooked broccoli and these thin large slice of carrot also floating on top.I had the curry chicken which was good, but definitely different than when I previously ordered it. This was our favorite restaurant. Would I recommend or return??????????
This is some of the best Mediterranean food I've ever had I highly recommend this spot! Enjoy!!!!

Solid Indian food in Media. Menu is deep and prices are good. Naan bread is fabulous and their curries and chicken berianni (sp?) is the best single dish on state street in media. I liked the old space better - was more authentic and new bar always seems empty. Service can be slow on some visits.
I love Ron's.. Their food is delicious... I advise please dont come here on a short temper because the staff can be very rude... My favorites are the stew chicken, curry shrimp, and jerk wings....

Having moved to St Petersburg from the U.K a few months ago, my wife and I have desperately been searching for some great Indian cuisine, as England is known for it's incredible Indian restaurants. Gateway To India has super service, great staff and a bubbly atmosphere but the food.........!!!! SO GOOD!!!!! Cooked to your personal specification, using the freshest of ingredients. We will definitely be returning for the lunchtime buffet sometime very soon!!!!!!! Thanks for a great dining experience.
Wow, what a nice suprise to find Thai food this good close to home. Will definetly come back and let our friends know!

Outstanding top to bottom. Food that you will dream about, a great wine list and drink selection & supa friendly staff & owner! Makes you wanna eat there every night! Not had one bad experience. Will be back when we visit Saint Louis again. Mussels and the PDO flatbread followed by filet 5 stars!!

Friendly, fast, and delicious. The GYRO is great. A little salty sometimes but very enjoyable. Some may find it a bit oily, but it's delicious and probably the best food to eat in the UCen. The CHICKEN is dry sometimes and doesn't compare in flavor to gyro. The falafel is fabulous. I love their FRIES. Who knew simple french fries could taste so good. Breakfast 7-11am is definitely worth it! Their BREAKFAST WRAP wakes you up and is so convenient for UCSB students and faculty. The prices are so affordable Greek food; ~$6-8 for a meal. The line is super quick and the employees are very friendly!
The best pad Thai ever! My husband and I love coming here! So glad they reopened 10th street making it easy to get to from Avon!

nice, compact menu with a lot of interesting flavors. mussels with green curry sauce comes with crispy basil, and the shrimp rolls are fried but not greasy. dishes aren't too heavy, and even the spicy ones don't leave your mouth ringing and your brain wondering why you ordered them. the drunken duck (not always on the menu) was a great treat -- crispy green beans, even more crispy skinned duck that was tender and in a smooth peanut sauce. ringed by some flaming rum, it was one of the most inventive and original thai dishes i've had.
Very quick service, quality food with love. University student and want to step your ramen game up? You gotta give Ninja Noodle a try! You'll thank me later.
My favorite Thai restaurant by far. Fresh ingredients, perfect spice levels, great lunch specials! The Panang Curry is my favorite dish and the black sweet rice for dessert is INSANELY good.

they weren't personable. Every time we asked for more water, a spice tray, or extra rice they acted very annoyed.... food was alright. cheap prices:) they gave us free pumpkin soup which was good. but the way they acted really afected my rating....

I do love Seasons. They have great Banh Mi's and boba. I love getting the Strawberry Yogurt boba with Strawberry bursting boba... so good. Taro is also an excellent choice. I've also tried the beef pho and was pretty happy with it. No complaints. Will keep coming back until I have a reason not to. :) Service isn't super fast but everything is fresh. Customer service is always friendly too.

Hard To find Vietnamese on a Sunday so this place was a SCORE!! Pho was tasty And just what I needed this weekend. We visited Sunday and it was packed but we didn't have to wait long for a table for two. We were seated ahead of a party of 3. Two tables cleared out fairly fast but the dishes were left for well Over 10 minutes. The Rangoon's were crispy yet the bacon seemed to be missing. Overall a good experience and we will be back if it's a Sunday and we're craving pho!!

One of the best BYOB joints in Philly. I've been here several times and have never been disappointed. I must say that the last time the food came out incredibly fast and our meal didn't last more than 30 minutes. That's what I call a speed dinner. I think they could have waited to take the food out another 10-15 minutes. Usually, I don't complain about this but it just felt kind of weird. They have the most authentic Laotian cuisine in the city and the service is very friendly. The ambiance is nice and quaint but still perfect for groups or small gatherings. I may need to give it a break considering there are so many other places to check out in the city but if I'm recommending a nice, delicious, cheap dinner with a BYOB policy, Vientiane is usually among the first places I mention.

Excellent Thai food. I worked in a Thai restraunt for 4yrs while in college and this place taste amazing. The only downside to this place is its VERY pricey. Like 2 people eating for 40$ pricey. Other than that is great!
Amazing! Delicious falafel wrap.... service was fast and fantastic. Feels like a great family owned environment / definitely recommend!
Awesome service staff! We visit Tryst on a regular basis and it's always top notch! Love the hummus, shrimp flatbread, and crab cakes!

If you are looking for a decent coffee or something to eat on the go, this is not a bad place to stop in. The prices are moderate and the product is decent. After my experience I would not recommend going there to study, read, or to get work done. For us laptop users that need electricity to do work, La Va doesn't offer much help. Although they offer free Wi-fi (every other coffee house in the city does that), there are only two outlets near the tables that people work and study at. That leads to the awkward conversations where you have to ask a stranger if you can unplug their laptop in favor of plugging yours in. It would probably be a savvy business investment to walk down the block to CVS and get that $10 multi-outlet extension cord. But there are more important things to consider. For example, how customers are treated. I was studying in La Va this week when I was approached by a staff member, presumably the manager, and asked to move from my seat. I was sitting at a 2-seat table studying, which I had occupied since the shop opened. The staff member asked me to move to a 4-seat table with 3 other strangers in the back of the shop. I asked her to elaborate, because I did not understand why I had to be moved. She stated that 'it's something we do here because of our space issue' and was insistent that I move. I found this to be very rude and bad business. If you're going to portray your coffee house as a place of comfort that you can go to read, study, and enjoy a cup of brew then you should do just that. Interrupting and asking your customers to move and squeeze into another table with people they don't know is not good business. There are plenty of other coffee shops in the area that will let you keep your seat while you study and enjoy your coffee. If space is such an issue a move might be in order. You need not look far, OCF realty is across the street.

If you want to know what I look like when I'm in love then watch me when I'm having lunch at this place. It is hands down the BEST Indian place for literally miles and miles around and trust me I *do* know what I'm yapping about. I'm one of those uber picky, ultra finicky vegetarians that takes her own food on each and every road trip because finding places to eat when I'm not at home always proves to be a nightmare. Usually though if there's an Indian Buffet in the town that I travel to *booyah* I get to eat 'normal' food that day. So suffice it to say I've eaten at a LOT of Indian Buffets. NONE of them compare to this place. Their bar always has a *least* four vegetarian sauces in addition to the normal salad and dessert sections. Their servers are a 'team' in that they are constantly circling making sure everyone's plates are cleared and glasses refilled. I absolutely LOVE to come here with a hearty appetite and be treated like a princess. It's quite easy to find near the Lafayette Square Mall on the West Side of Indy off of 38th St and you get sooooo very much delicious tastiness for your $8! I have been here for dinner and everything is equally as fresh and delicious but you really cannot beat that lunch buffet deal for getting your fill of a variety of dishes all at once. Today there was mushroom masala (to die for) in addition to I think five other sauces. They generally have two types of bread And two types of rice. I always have to take a nap when I leave this place because I send myself into a carb overload! I've been coming here for years and the quality of their food and service has only improved. Check them out early and often! Don't forget to get your buffet stamp because after 8 the ninth one is free! I've claimed this prize at least three times so far!
It's alway a consistent stop when I travel. Food always good and you know what to expect. Good food and good service.

On weekends, they have basically two options: 8-course meat sampling or 8-course vegetarian sampling for $25 a person. We tried the meat one, and had lamb and chicken. The courses: soup, bread/dip spread, chicken pie with powdered sugar, chicken, lamb, cous cous, fruit, and baklava. Out of the entire course, I enjoyed only the chicken, although it was a roasted kind which most of us could make ourselves in a crock pot. The fruit had bananas, oranges, and apples. I was told the apples were "soft" and the bananas looked green, so the oranges were the only ripe option. So, I enjoyed the chicken and orange. The ambiance was different, it felt like we were in a canopy tent. Every so often the belly dancer would come out. She was a good dancer, so it entertaining if you like that sort of thing. I think the guys in our group enjoyed it. Has hookah, so many groups came in towards the later hours to do that. But during dinner, it felt like we were the only group actually dining. I thought the food was not good, and overpriced to boot. I will not be coming back.

Holy moly, they definitely made the shwarma at this place better (compared to when it was Mama's Grill). The seasoning was great! I shared a shwarma platter with my friend and it was enough for both of us to not feel like a bowling ball ready to be rolled over. And I'm pretty sure the pitas were served at room temperature before which would annoy me to no end (I'm Indian, I like my naan and pitas warmed up!) But now, they are nice and warm :) Since my best friend keeps kosher, I'm pretty sure this won't be my last time coming here. Please don't disappoint me, Chickpeas!!

Friendly, clean and great food! We have found our new best Indian restaurant in Indy! The butter chicken, Tandoori chicken and chicken seek kababs are delicious. The nan is soft, fresh and tasty. The Dal and bhindi were cooked to perfection. The food portions are generous. We have been here twice now and the food continues to be great! We are looking forward to trying out the buffet so we can discover other flavorful dishes. Highly recommend this place. They were also able to make the dishes mild so that my 6 and 8 yr old could enjoy it! Don't forget to try the deserts (gulab jaman) and masala chai.
Great spot but PLEASE spring for some fly paper!! Constantly attacked by swarming flies.

I've eaten here numerous times for lunch, and while I have had better, this isn't such a bad place. The food generally consistent and had good flavor. There's usually a nice group here during lunch time and the portions are generous. What I don't really understand is why this establishment insists on charging an extra $2 if you choose to share your meal. It isn't like they took an effort to split the dish in half and presented the customer with two plates. They simply brought out a smaller plate. That's all.
Love this place! Everything is fantastic. Best Thia in the area. Go. Bring your friends!

Is run by an old guy with the old style of talking, kinda nice to hear him talk. He will likely ask you not to stand on one side of the van as he is frying falafel and does not want oil to fall on us. He also might say that such things can confuse his brain. One lady didn't want the plastic bag, he refused and said no i can't do that, i have to put a lot of things in the bag and then told her to enjoy the day. Some people may not like that, but i liked him, reminded me of my grand father. Very nice guy with an old style of talking, he is not one of those guys who would put on a fake smile to his customers. Coming to food - it was yummy, worth 10$. The chicken was good, had the charcoal smell and tender. Falafel was tasty too. I give him 10 on 10.

I discovered Sam's 15 years ago when I briefly lived in Port Richey. It is a great place to go watch the sunset and have a cocktail. Whenever I visit that area, I make a point to stop in. The service has always been great and their prices are reasonable. Have to brag on their stuffed mushrooms. The caps are huge and full of crab and are nothing short of delicious. Their calamari is also very good. I've only had apps here but they do have a full menu. If you are ever in the area, I would recommend stopping in for a specialty cocktail and awesome view of the sunset on the gulf. Oh, and try the stuffed mushrooms!
If you're craving dosa or true South Indian spice, this is the place. Very authentic food according to all my Indian friends. We visit often!
What a GREAT restaurant! Service was fast and friendly. Our Aloo Gobi and Chicken Tikka Masala were fabulous!!! And the naan was YUM!

I really enjoyed the food the curry is absolutely wonderful. ( you need to get it native Thai hot though. The Tom Kai soup very tasty. They are busy every time I go there tells you something hua? Price I would say would be $$ to $$$.

Went here with a bunch of guys in my motorcycle group. Now there were 15 of us, so service is always difficult with a group that large, but our waitress did an ok job. My issue with this place is the food. The fried oysters were so over breaded that it was hard to tell there was an oyster in the middle. The location is good and has potential, just need to work on the execution.

3 1/2 starts is just right, but I'll bump it to 4 because I like the idea of a neighborhood Greek mezze joint, the place has a nice atmosphere, and the belly dancer knew how to shake it with a smile. Things that I would not order again: Falafel -- 3 pucks on a pita w/ hummus, a bunch of cucumber/onion/tomato, with feta and tzatziki on the side. Looked real nice, unfortunately the falafel was pretty tasteless, as was the hummus. But when you combine everything it's not so bad. Bacon Phyllo -- bacon, mushrooms, and other stuff wrapped in phyllo dough, served over some marinara. Kinda boring. Beef Dolmades -- poorly wrapped, not much beef, ok flavor. Things I would order again: Mussels -- served in a flavorful tomato broth with a lot of veggies in it, pretty delicious. Sea Bass w/ lemon Orzo -- YES! my favorite item here. The fish, orzo, and lemon cream sauce make an awesome combo. Get this. My friend and I waiited about 20 mins on 8pm Friday night for seating. Decent service. Every item ordered was around 10 bucks.
A typical Indian restaurant, serving a buffet for lunch and offering a full menu for dinner. The food is well-made and tasty. A good choice for an inexpensive lunch.

The food was worth every penny and more. We are very picky with Indian restaurants,but Guru met our standards and more! We had cheese and garlic naan(delicious) with two orders of paneer tikka masala. The naan was amazing and the paneer was definitely the best I had. They surprised us with a delicious FREE appetizer, and afterwards gave us a FREE rice pudding dessert. The staff were friendly and service was great. The restaurant was very clean and cute. It total, our bill came up to just a mere $30 for two meals,drinks,naan,an appetizer,and desert. Definitely worth coming back to.

So impressed with everything about this place from the laid back Greek inspired atmosphere complete with beautiful murals to the awesome authentic Greek food. Delicious. Seriously the best fries I've ever had. The pitas, hummus appetizers, soups and salads were all a hit with my crew. Friendly, quick service and did I mention the Greek wine? Highly recommend. We didn't dine out back on the patio, but the atmosphere and outdoor bar looks super cool. Thanks for adding diversity to the cuisine of East Nashville! Y'all are not disappointing!!!!

The food is excellent. At least the dish I had. Pork tenderloin with Greek salad and asparagus and a side of roasted potatoes. That sounds like a lot but for me it was just the right size. I wish I had taken a picture of my meal before I started eating it was presented beautifully. The service was a little slow but that was because they only had one girl doing refills and serving dinners, and while they weren't real busy, the restaurant really needed two possible three people doing that job. I will come back simply because the meal I had was a good change from the regular fast food joints.

Really great Panang Beef Curry. Rich, creamy, and with perfectly cooked. The vegetables were done just right. The beef was shaved thin. The rice was fragrant and just sticky enough to sop up all that good sauce. Clean atmosphere. Very friendly and pleasant service. And, the prices make this place a good value.
Stopped in on a saturday afternoon. Was seated immediately, drinks and food were great. Recommend the quesadillas and nachos!

This is my go to place for sit-down or takeout. BYOB and cash, so be forewarned. There is nothing better than the King's Soup on a cold winter's night. The Nam Salad is like nothing I've ever had before or since.

Update on Orchids Thai: They are going downhill. Food quality and service are slipping. We have noticed these changes over the course of several visits recently. "Mom", who used to cook there regularly, has clearly retired, or is no longer there for whatever reason, and the food quality has suffered noticeably. Noodle dishes are greasy, vegetables are cheap and frozen from out of a bag, service is slow, and not nearly as nice as it used to be. When we asked a question about some of our food, we got a "lecture" from the older lady serving us instead of an offer to help or an apology. Not worth it anymore. We won't be back.
Best food ever eaten in North America ... Just need to work on service that all but not bad ...i am going life time costumer ...

The service was wonderful. the owner welcomed us as if we were family. My husband mentioned that he wanted to eat more vegan as we were walking down the buffet, so she had the chef make some vegan food for my husband. The spices were that perfect Indian mix. This may become my regular restaurant.

I believe this is the only Indian dinner buffet in town, and its a true bargain at $12.99. The food was good, service prompt and courteous, and the restaurant clean and well maintained. This was the first time that I had dosas and they were delish! Also this was my first time trying spinach with paneer cheese and I will say that I am a fan. I wish that they'd had samosas and vegetable pakoras on the buffet but otherwise they had many of my favorite entrees. The one draw back was that they played awful music and they played it loudly. No thank you.
We loved it and planning to go back soon ! Great and fresh falafel and delicious and fresh salads. Simple and tasty he cooked tasting foods -delicious !

If I ate here on a consistent basis, I'd weigh a thousand pounds and be on those dia-beetus commercials with Wilford Brimley However, I would be a happy diabetic because Gigi and Big R's food is mighty tasty. I had a chance to try this truck when they were at the Navy Yard's Food Truck Lineup. I ordered a chicken breast platter with a side of string beans and candied yams. I originally wanted mac-n-cheese but they were all out :( The one odd thing I noticed is that none of the prices are listed on the outside of the truck. I ordered a small platter and it was $10. Not sure how much the large platter is. The food itself was delicious, but definitely not something I could eat everyday. I found it strange that the chicken breast had the bone attached? Weird, but it was seasoned and cooked just right, so I didn't mind. The candied yams were the star of the meal, but how could something covered in sugar and butter not be amazing? The string beans were good too- very garlic-y and butter-y. I would definitely try Gigi and Big R again... but only if I had already gone to the gym that day and only planned on eating salads for the next three days.

Walked in and the smell was enticing. Was originally recommended to this place because of a take out order which was delivered to a store we were at. Food was very good and they give a military discount.

Reluctant to walk in because the restaurant looked empty at lunch time. Saw all of the yelp stars and went in. I am glad! Very clean. Nice service. Most importantly yummy food! They have a lunch special every day! What restaurant does that?!? Loved it! Definitely will come back!

So i finally tried this place after passing it for years. Pretty decent Mediterranean food. Nice lunch specials. You get a lot of food for your buck. My favorite was the falafel. Very tasty. Good kabobs, hummus and pitas. All around good.

I have to start again by saying that St. Louis' selection of good Korean dining establishments is pretty scarce. Seriously, the ladies at my church make the best Korean food available in the St. Louis area I'm pretty sure. Overall, Hangook Kwan was pretty good. I had the "bulgogi," which is the traditional bbq beef/meat. It's one I like to try first when I go to Korean restaurants because it helps me gauge how authentic the restaurant is overall. The meat was juicy and tender and there was a good amount of side dishes ("bahn-chaan") that came with the meal. I'd say that the bulgogi here is better than Joo Joo's. The pieces were bigger and tasted more fresh and less oily. The service was very timely and friendly, and I'd definitely tell my St. Louis friends to give it a try if they're looking for good Korean food in the St. Louis area. Or, if you're REALLY one of my friends, maybe I'll take you to my church so you can have some really really good stuff.

pho hoa is this nuts chain that i've seen a lot in california before but this particular location was huge! the other one's i've been to only had a limited selection on the menu but this philly location could do it all. I had hu tieu and the broth was a little thick for my liking but it wasn't bad.
